g12-ch2-board-03.s: $AC=13$ [1]. $\tan A=\frac{BC}{AB}=\frac{12}{5}$, $\tan C=\frac{5}{12}$ [1]. $\sin A=\frac{12}{13}$, $\cos C=\frac{12}{13}$ [2]. Angle sum of the triangle gives $A+C=\pi-\frac\pi2$ [1].
